summary.text: Lauri Shillings, a Libertarian graphic designer, business owner and adjunct professor from Carmel, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Indiana Secretary of State to Beau Bayh.
She is the Hamilton County Libertarian chair and a creative director at the University of Indianapolis.

paragraphs.text: Shillings was born in Indiana. She earned an associate degree from Ivy Tech Community College and a bachelor's degree from the University of Indianapolis in 2023.

Her career has included work as a graphic designer, business owner, adjunct professor and director, and, as of March 2026, she was creative director in the University of Indianapolis marketing office.
She has been affiliated with the Libertarian Party of Indiana and has chaired the party's Hamilton County organization since 2021.
She was the Libertarian candidate for Indiana's 5th Congressional District in 2024 and lost in the general election.
The party nominated her for secretary of state at its state convention in Fort Wayne in March 2026; she lives in Carmel.
She received 2.0% of the vote to Beau Bayh's 51.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
